description: ABOUT QUALIFYCODE AI has made it trivial to fabricate resumes, take-home assignments, and remote interviews. QualifyCode is the integrity layer for technical hiring—helping engineering teams verify candidate work objectively while keeping every hiring decision explainable, auditable, and fair. We are a small, product-focused team in Mumbai running a live production platform used in real hiring workflows. Our product spans a proctored web coding IDE, a recruiter decision console, isolated code-execution pipelines, and automated integrity and code-quality analysis services. Everything is built and owned in-house, end to end. THE ROLE We’re looking for a Software Engineer to work across the full stack rather than a single siloed layer. Our system combines event-driven workflows, service-to-service APIs, and real-time client communication—so your work will span React interfaces, TypeScript and Python backend services, PostgreSQL data models, and asynchronous job queues. At this stage of our growth, the core engineering focus is scale, reliability, and hardening—driving down end-to-end latency, optimizing database queries, refining access controls, and strengthening distributed concurrency. This role fits someone who reads how a production system actually behaves before changing it, and who ships verified fixes over quick guesses. WHAT YOU’LL OWN • Candidate Coding Experience: Build and harden our browser-based IDE—editing workflows, resilient autosave, live execution feedback over WebSockets, pre-assessment environment checks, and reliable media uploads. • Recruiter Decision Console: Develop the dashboard hiring managers rely on under time pressure—candidate reports, code-quality and integrity breakdowns, session timelines, review queues, and synchronized media playback. • Core Backend & Orchestration: Design and scale APIs and state machines handling assessment lifecycles, candidate sessions, RBAC, usage accounting, and asynchronous workflows with clean contracts and idempotent failure handling. • Analysis & Scoring Pipelines: Extend our code-quality and integrity pipelines across deterministic scoring rules, telemetry processing, computer-vision signals, and bounded LLM integrations—keeping results accurate and explainable. • Reliability & Observability: Improve resilience across execution sandboxes, PostgreSQL databases, Redis queues, and object storage. Debug issues with distributed traces and metrics, and back every fix with regression tests. OUR STACK You don't need prior fluency in every tool, but you should be strong in TypeScript and comfortable moving across frontend state, backend APIs, SQL query plans, and Python services: • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, Monaco Editor, Socket.IO, browser media/WASM APIs • Backend: Node.js (NestJS, Prisma, Express), Python (FastAPI) • Data & Async: PostgreSQL, Redis, S3-compatible object storage, BullMQ, Celery, Server-Sent Events • Infra & Observability: Docker, Linux, GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, k6 WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR • 1–4 years of production experience shipping full-stack web applications (or equivalent demonstrated depth). • Strong TypeScript & React fundamentals—able to reason across UI state, API lifecycles, and relational schemas in the same afternoon. • Solid backend engineering: Practical grasp of HTTP semantics, auth/RBAC, idempotency, transactions, and fault-tolerant queue retries. • PostgreSQL beyond CRUD: Comfortable with joins, indexing, migrations, and reading EXPLAIN plans. • High engineering rigor: You verify changes with tests, traces, or benchmarks before calling them done. • Immediate availability to join our Mumbai office (Hybrid). Bonus points for: A live project or readable GitHub repo with real users; experience debugging distributed race conditions or retry storms; production LLM or media/computer-vision integrations; Python async services (FastAPI/Celery); or work in audited domains like HR tech or fintech. HOW WE ENGINEER • Contract-first APIs: Shared schemas, pagination standards, and permission models are strictly typed across services. • Verification by default: Bug fixes ship with regression tests; auth changes include negative (403) tests; performance work includes measurements. • Zero-downtime evolution: Database and API changes roll out via staged, backward-compatible migrations. • Safe rollouts & CI guardrails: Feature flags, shadow-mode validation for automated scoring, and automated CI checks for timeouts and bounded queries. HOW TO APPLY Please apply at https://qualifycode.com/careers (and include the following in your application or Wellfound note): 1. A working link to something you built (a live product, open-source contribution, or GitHub repo we can read). 2. One line on which part of our stack or problem space you’d most want to own.

description: Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at [bitwarden.com](http://bitwarden.com). As a Senior Software Engineer on Bitwarden’s Privileged Access Management (PAM) team, you will lead the design and development of our next-generation privileged access platform. You'll own critical gateway services, terminal access protocols, and auditing/enforcement at the intersection of security, scalability, and user experience. In alignment with our modern **True Ownership** model, our engineers are "T-shaped" professionals who own their services end-to-end—from initial design and secure development to automated testing, deployment, and operational health in production. This role offers unique opportunities to build secure-by-default patterns and make significant contributions to our open-source security ecosystem. **RESPONSIBILITIES** - **End-to-End Delivery:** Support Bitwarden goals by designing, developing, testing, deploying, and operating secure, performant gateway controls, audited terminal logins, and session recording mechanics for our PAM product line. - **Decoupled Architecture:** Maintain strict service boundaries and design resilient APIs that allow the PAM platform to operate as an independent, decoupled tenant on our core platform infrastructure. - **Upstream Collaboration:** Partner closely in a co-located, cross-functional "Embedded Trio" (Product, Design, and Engineering) to rapidly design and validate technical solutions prior to code implementation. - **Automated Quality:** Eliminate manual testing barriers by building and maintaining robust automated test suites, integration harnesses, and CI/CD pipelines for your team's services. - **Operational Stewardship:** Own the operational health, performance, and reliability telemetry of your services in production, proactively participating in sustainable on-call rotations and postmortem analyses. - **Documentation:** Build and maintain high-quality internal architecture specifications, API contracts, and external open-source developer documentation. **WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN** - **Overall Experience: 4+ years** as a Software Engineer with team lead experience paired with AI assisted development practices, including experience leading a team's technical direction, mentoring senior engineers and being accountable for outcomes you did not implement yourself. - **Quality:** Experience with JEST or any other unit testing framework. Set the bar in pull request review and own the team's conventions for testing, error handling, API design, and secure coding, keeping automated suites, integration harnesses, and CI/CD pipelines strong enough that manual testing is never the safety net. Maintain the architecture specifications, API contracts, and open source developer documentation that go with them. - **Technical Stack:**Strong proficiency and experience in AI-Led Development in C# / .NET, Rust, or TypeScript. - **Security Domain Expertise:** Practical experience designing or implementing secure gateway architectures, reverse proxies, and session proxying (SSH, RDP, or HTTPS). - **Identity & Auditing:** Understanding of Identity and Access Management, key-rotation protocols, and real-time audit logging systems. - **T-Shaped Engineering Mindset:** Practical experience with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes), automated test frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and SRE/observability tools (APM, alerting, and telemetry dashboards). - **Secure Coding:** Familiarity with zero-trust and zero-knowledge security architectures, encryption standards and threat-modeling methodologies. - **Collaborative Spirit:** A highly collaborative and adaptable mindset, excited to work in rapid, outcome-driven feedback loops. - **Open Source Passion:** Excitement and enthusiasm for open source, developer advocacy, and building a more secure internet. - **Problem-Solving:** Excellent problem-solving skills—valuing written, clear documentation and using data to make technical decisions. ## **Why Join Us** This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up. Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations. Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization & contribute to products used by customers around the world. If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you. ## **Equal Opportunity Employer** We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

description: Sit with the companies building on Isomorph, ship the software their teams run on, and make it work for every customer after them. ## The role Our first enterprise customers are finance and operations teams, buried in work no software ever covered: reconciliations, approvals, payouts, reports stitched together from spreadsheets and email. Their own people are now building apps and agents for that work with AI. Some get them live in a day. Others get stuck on a messy system, a missing connection, or a question nobody at their company can answer. You will be the engineer who sits with them. You will work closely with about three early customers, learn how their teams really work, build and ship their apps and agents on Isomorph, and connect them to the systems they already depend on. You will be based in Bengaluru, often at their offices, and everything you learn there comes back into the product. ## What you'll own - The apps and agents your customers depend on, from the first conversation to running in production. - Connections into the systems they run on: spreadsheets, email, ERP, accounting and HR systems, databases and APIs. - Getting the builders at your customers unstuck, fast, and showing them what is possible. - The trust of each customer's business teams and their IT, as the person who gets it done. - Turning what you see in the field into product changes, so the next customer gets it for free. ## What you'll get to build next - Turn the patterns you see across customers into ready-made connectors, agents and playbooks that every Isomorph customer can use. - Get to a world where a new customer goes from first call to apps in production in days, mostly without needing us. - Shape how forward deployed engineering works at Isomorph as the team grows. ## You'll thrive here if - You have 2-6 years of building and shipping real software, and some of that time was in front of customers. - You have tamed messy business systems (ERPs, accounting or HR tools, old databases, flaky APIs) and made them reliable. - You live in AI coding agents and can put a working app in front of someone the same day. - You can sit with a finance lead or an IT head, understand the real problem, and explain the fix in plain words. - You take ownership: when a customer is stuck, it is your problem until it is solved, and then you make sure it never happens again. ## Why Isomorph For fifty years, software inside a company has been written by a small group of engineers, for everyone else. That is ending. With AI, the people who know the work best (the finance analyst, the ops lead, the recruiter, the support manager) can now build the software they need themselves. Most of them have never written a line of code. This is one of the biggest shifts in how companies work, and it has a missing piece. The software these people build is useful, and very often unsafe: no sign-in, sensitive data exposed, nobody to run it, and invisible to IT. Multiply that across a large company and you get thousands of apps and agents that nobody governs. Isomorph is the foundation that software runs on. Bring an app or agent built with any AI tool, and Isomorph runs it on the company's own cloud: secured, connected to company data and systems, monitored and kept healthy. Builders never think about infrastructure. IT stays in control of everything. We believe every company will become AI-native one workflow at a time, built by its own people. Isomorph is where that software will live. The team. You will join a small, high-talent-density founding team from IIT Madras and IIT Delhi. The founders are second-time founders who have built companies before and sold one. ## Why you'll love it here - You'll be early. You will be one of the first people on the team, with real ownership and a real say in what Isomorph becomes. - You'll work at the frontier. AI agents and enterprise-grade infrastructure, applied to a problem every company is about to have. - You'll see your impact. We work side by side with customers, so what you ship is in real people's hands within days. - You'll build the way the future builds. We build Isomorph with AI agents ourselves, so your leverage is your judgment and your taste, not your typing speed. - You'll grow fast. Small team, huge surface, founders who have built and scaled before.
